# Propeller Picks

> Propeller Picks is an AI-assisted player-prop research workspace for web and mobile. It was designed for DFS and pick'em platforms, does not accept or place wagers, and is not affiliated with the platforms it references.

Last verified: 2026-07-25
Canonical site: https://propellerpicks.com/
App signup: https://app.propellerpicks.com/signup
Public API base: https://web-production-3c1c4.up.railway.app
Machine-readable data catalog: https://propellerpicks.com/data/index.json
Curated public agent API: https://web-production-3c1c4.up.railway.app/api/public/agent/v1/index
Curated public OpenAPI: https://web-production-3c1c4.up.railway.app/api/public/agent/v1/openapi.json

## What Propeller Provides

- AI-assisted player prop research for NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, and soccer.
- Best fit: beginners and casual DFS and pick'em players who want the reasons behind a player line in plain English, without sportsbook jargon, for $15/month after a free tier.
- The signed-in product supports NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and soccer. PGA is no longer supported (owner correction September 14, 2026). The free public analyzer currently exposes NBA, NHL, MLB, NFL, and soccer; availability varies by slate and data.
- Core platform-fit workflows are PrizePicks, Underdog Fantasy, and DraftKings Pick6. Sportsbook lines such as FanDuel may appear only as market context.
- Sport-specific analysis signals contribute when available; Propeller does not publish a universal agent count.
- Confidence is a 50-100 directional model-confidence score, not a calibrated win probability or guarantee.
- Documented historical archive with raw-row and collapsed-ledger definitions.
- Limited daily public pick previews for website pages.
- Player analyzer cards, stat breakdowns, payout calculators, and comparison guides.
- A public model card and day-one first-observed publication ledger. The ledger does not verify event-start ordering or outcome timing.
- Web app and mobile companion for deeper research workflows.
- MLB hitter fantasy projections with a floor, point estimate, and ceiling under DraftKings MLB scoring. Pitchers, other sports, lineup optimization, and guaranteed outcomes are not part of the public launch.

## Current Historical Data Snapshot

Source snapshot generated: July 13, 2026
Canonical explanation: https://propellerpicks.com/results/

- Historical database: 2,116,581 raw graded analysis rows.
- Current public-ledger collapse: 284,005 prop-result entries.
- Raw-to-ledger ratio: 7.45x.
- Current sports represented: NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, and soccer.

These historical records include repeated analysis snapshots and legacy retrospective data. They are research records, not a uniquely published forward-test, ROI, profit, or future-performance claim. Use the canonical report before quoting any aggregate figure.

## Pricing

The public analyzer is free to use without an account. The free tier needs no payment card and includes up to five current picks per supported sport. The standalone full-workspace subscription is $15 USD/month total, including applicable tax, with no automatic trial, available to eligible new accounts through the limited web purchase pilot. MCP access for compatible AI tools is included with full workspace access, including protected existing free accounts. Your AI tool's own plan and usage limits still apply. Existing free accounts keep their full access free. Existing Founder 500 lifetime core entitlements remain honored. MCP server URL: https://mcp.propellerpicks.com/mcp (setup guide: https://propellerpicks.com/mcp/).

## Legal And Safety

Propeller Picks is for research and analysis only. Propeller is not a sportsbook, does not accept wagers, and does not place bets for users. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Users are responsible for following local laws and responsible-gaming rules. For gambling help in the United States, call or text 1-800-GAMBLER.
